paragraphs: The day's rhythm is care, activities, and communication. Check children in and confirm attendance in the morning. Lead activities while monitoring safety, manage the difficult midday nap, and organize outdoor play in the afternoon. At pickup, tell each parent how much the child ate, how well they slept, and whether any injuries occurred.
